title: Amazing Crispy Argentinian Potato Empanadas
description: A cultured and chewy Argentinian dish featuring vegan white wine vinegar and a double-fry method, these empanadas are a quick-fix delight. They are satvik-friendly and perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and pepper.
Gradually add the white wine vinegar and olive oil to the flour mixture, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of chopped onion and a tablespoon of diced potato in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Double-fry the empanadas by frying them at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes, then increasing the temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot.
